LanguageData.LP_HeroPactBlast.label: pactbound eldritch blast
LanguageData.LP_HeroPactBlast.description: The Pactbound's pact spell: a beam of force (range 24), each beam 12 eldritch damage (armor penetration 30%). Number of beams by adventurer level: 1 at levels 1-4, 2 at 5-10, 3 at 11-16, 4 from 17; if the target falls, the remaining beams automatically fire at nearby enemies. Costs no neural heat. Cooldown 4 seconds. Can't be used during the patron's wrath.
LanguageData.LP_HeroFeyStep.label: fey step
LanguageData.LP_HeroFeyStep.description: Step into the Feywild and back out: teleport to a visible open spot within 8 cells. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_HeroHurlHell.label: straight to hell
LanguageData.LP_HeroHurlHell.description: Exaltation of the Pactbound (Fiend): hurl an enemy on a tour of the Nine Hells. For 10 seconds the target can't move and takes 6 burn damage per second (60 total). Once per day.
LanguageData.LP_HeroFeyCharm.label: fey charm
LanguageData.LP_HeroFeyCharm.description: Exaltation of the Pactbound (Fey): enemies within 6 cells are entranced by fey song and dazed for 10 seconds (no effect on bosses, legendary units or demigods). Once per day.
LanguageData.LP_HeroTentacles.label: otherworldly tentacles
LanguageData.LP_HeroTentacles.description: Exaltation of the Pactbound (Old One): tear open a rift from beyond the stars in an area of ground (radius 3); enemies inside are trapped by tentacles for 15 seconds, taking 3 damage per second. Once per day.
LanguageData.LP_HeroFateMaster.label: master of fate
LanguageData.LP_HeroFateMaster.description: Exaltation of the child of prophecy: the next attack always hits for ×2 damage. Once per day.
LanguageData.LP_HeroWeaveSurge.label: weave surge
LanguageData.LP_HeroWeaveSurge.description: Exaltation of the Child of the Weave: for 60 seconds, casting costs no neural heat and triggers no cooldown. Once per day.
